pageDescription: Your admin tools, gathered in one place.
noAccess: You do not have access to this page.

capabilities.title: What you can do
capabilities.supportInbox: Handle support requests: read and reply, assign requests to yourself, and close or reopen threads
capabilities.directMessage: Send a direct message to an individual user
capabilities.manageFood: Manage the global Calculeat list that every user searches: copy one of your own food items into it, edit it, and delete it
capabilities.recipeRequests: Read and clear recipe requests users submit via Recipes → Discover
capabilities.publishRecipes: Publish one of your own recipes to the recipe bank, making it official and visible to everyone under Recipes → Discover (and unpublish it again)
capabilities.preview: Try the app as a new user in a sandbox, without touching your own data
capabilities.freeView: See the app as a free user to check what is locked
capabilities.superAdminNote: As a super admin you can also:
capabilities.grantPremium: Grant free premium to a user and see their full subscription history

support.title: Support
support.description: The inbox of user requests. Opens in its own view because the threads need the full screen.

premium.title: Premium
premium.description: Search for a user to see their subscription history and grant free premium. The reason you enter is saved to the history.

drift.title: Recipe bank nutrition
drift.description: A recipe is only recalculated when it is saved again. If a global food item changes, official recipes keep their old values until someone updates them.
drift.none: All official recipes match their ingredients.
drift.howToFix: Open the recipe under My recipes, make a change and save it again — the nutrition is then recalculated with current values.

message.title: Send a message to a user
